condition: recombinant WT IMEF cargo-loaded compartment expressed in E. coli
notes: Canonical WT cargo-loaded T=4 assembly. Giessen et al. 2019 directly reported a 240-subunit T=4 icosahedral shell approximately 42 nm in diameter and 9.6 MDa in mass. PDB 6NJ8 / EMD-9383 represents the IMEF cargo-loaded compartment; targeting-peptide density is modeled in the atomic shell structure while the full IMEF cargo is less ordered. The cargo-loaded compartment has a reported melting temperature of 88.9 °C. Compartments isolated under high-iron conditions reached 91.8 °C, but this represents increased stabilization by internal mineralized material rather than a distinct shell assembly.
